_comment: Tuning suite. Edit the knowledge MD files, then `node harness/run.mjs` to regenerate and rebuild the contact sheet. The current MVP path is knowledge-driven (no language/structure needed) — these cases just send a brief; the agent infers the component and reasons from the knowledge.

cases.brief: A feature card for an AI customer-support tool. The capability: it drafts the reply, pulls the order history, and routes the hard cases to a human. Show it working.
cases.note: Diorama principle — chat/order scene with floating panels.

cases.brief: A Pro plan pricing card at $24/mo: 5 included seats, unlimited projects, priority support, and a 14-day free trial CTA. Mark it as most popular.
cases.note: Big-number price hero, included list, emphasized CTA.

cases.brief: A stat card proving median first-reply time of 2m 41s across 4,800 live inboxes this week, with a small supporting trend chart and an improvement delta.
A hero section for a product-analytics platform that turns raw events into clear answers. Benefit-led headline, one primary action, and a representative dashboard visual.
cases.note: Headline-led, generous space, a product visual.

cases.brief: A testimonial card: a founder of a logistics startup says the product cut their support backlog from days to under an hour. Include name, role, company, and an avatar.
A final call-to-action section inviting teams to start a free trial of an AI workflow tool. Punchy headline, one dominant button, reassurance line.
cases.note: Singular focus, dominant button, distinct field.
